categories.name: tool error hidden
categories.definition: A tool result carries an error object, yet the answer reports a success that no tool produced (tr-0001: the lookup failed and the answer still states a number).

categories.name: wrong item
categories.definition: The tool arguments or the answer name a catalog item different from the one the operator asked for (tr-0006 asks for one item and reserves another).

categories.name: invented source
categories.definition: The answer cites a runbook or incident report id that is not among the retrieved passages (tr-0002 cites IR-120 while only IR-031 and RB-04 were retrieved).

categories.name: quantity miscounted
categories.definition: The request gives packs and a pack size and the reserved quantity is not their product (tr-0004).

categories.name: unit ignored
categories.definition: The request names a pack unit such as boxes and the reserve call books the same number in pieces (tr-0026).

categories.name: cut off
categories.definition: finish_reason is length and the answer stops mid-sentence although the passages were adequate (tr-0014).

categories.name: refused a valid request
categories.definition: An ordinary supply request receives a refusal and no tool is called (tr-0020).
